Avsikten med den svenska insatsen är att bidra till att stärka administrativ och teknisk kompetens hos funktionärer inom regeringsorgan samt halvstatliga och självständiga organisationer, genom deltagande i av Sida arrangerade Internationella kurser inom ITP-programmet inom områden relevanta för genomförandet av Bangladesh femåriga utvecklingsplaner. Fonden ska användas för resekostnader för de bangladeshiska kandidater som har utvalts och godkänts för deltagande i ovan nämnda kurser.

The purpose of the Swedish contribution is to help strengthen administrative and technical capabilities of the officers of Government, semi-Government and autonomous organizations through participation in the International Training Programme / Courses arranged by the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida) in areas of relevance for implementation of the Bangladesh Five Year Plans. The Fund is to be used for travel-related costs for Bangladeshi candidates that have been approved to participate in international training programmes/courses arranged by the Swedish International Development Co-operation Agency, Sida.

The objective of the Swedish contribution is to help strengthen administrative and technical capabilities of the officers of Government, semi­ Government and autonomous organizations through participation in the International Training Programme / Courses arranged by the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida) in areas of relevance. This contribution was not like other regular contributions. This contributions was earmarked only to provide air ticket to the participants of Sida ITP programme and only be given upon approval from GOB. The result of this contribution was kind of an unexpected one as, soon after establishing this Fund very little of it were utilized. This was because of the fact that Sida ITP organizers started to cover 100% cost of all participants including international Air Tickets. Project targets were achieved as ITP participants continued to take part in the training program's.Financial results were not achieved as very little money were used from this Fund to cover the ticket cost.
